what: blaze_ids::Hasher has no `opt_part`, but v2 code calls it as an inherent chained method: base-db lib.rs:208,437, input.rs:260,263,879; blaze-items key.rs:89-90; hir-def deps/key.rs:217, deps/reads.rs:211 (E0599 in the front-def check). base-db content.rs:81 documents `opt_bytes` as "what Hasher::opt_part hashes", so add to crates/blaze-ids/src/lib.rs `impl Hasher`, encoding exactly as opt_bytes does (0 for None, else 1 then a u64-length-prefixed part): `pub fn opt_part(&mut self, part: Option<impl AsRef<[u8]>>) -> &mut Hasher { match part { None => self.update(&[0]), Some(part) => self.update(&[1]).part(part.as_ref()) } }`. Callers pass Option<&str> and Option<String> (process_env_var, Version::to_string), so the generic takes both without a clone.
